cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.

comparison: Neighborhood first impression differs from a formal sporting bargain.
seedUse: Keep dismissive carelessness and name beside plate but make public presentation a live duty.
